title: timeline.add_transition
description: Attach a transition to one edge of a clip, consuming 'duration'. 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.4 timeline.add_transition; 'type' uses the engine transition shader ids crossdissolve|fade|wipe|slide (crates/oak-node/src/nodes/transitions.rs TYPE_NAMES/SHADER_IDS). The legacy tool only offered 'dissolve', which maps to 'crossdissolve'.

clip.description: Clip that owns the transition edge.

duration.description: Total transition length; each side consumes half.

oneOf.description: Frame index (>= 0). The T1 adapter converts it to Rational using the active sequence/footage frame rate and quantizes to the frame grid.
